help: start the markdown server (LaTeX rendering + turn deep links)

args.name: --markdown
args.help: the markdown tree to serve (default: data/output/markdown)

args.name: --daemon
args.help: run in the background (detached), rather than in the foreground

sends: reaches ensure-assets when render libs are missing — the first serve on a fresh clone downloads them (refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND: serve will not start half-rendered)
